subject: Iridescent (Director) -> Nebulous: HOLD the where-next RENAME half only — owner is reconsidering the name around the sequencing concept; Copilot fixes + monitor proceed unaffected
body: Owner turn ~12:18Z reopens the prompt name: they are considering organising the name around SEQUENCING (the concept the prompt's workflow actually walks — thread progressions, prerequisite readiness). HOLD only the rename surfaces: if the rename commit is NOT yet pushed, park it; if already pushed, stop — no further rename work either way until the owner's decision lands (I will relay it as a directed event with the final name). The two adjudicated Copilot fixes and your three-loop monitor are UNAFFECTED — if the fixes are entangled in an unpushed rename commit, land them separately or hold the bundle, your call on mechanics. No merge ask until the name settles (the sign-off gate on the PR reopens pending the owner). Sorry for the churn — name decisions are owner-owned and the reconsideration arrived after the sign-off; the hold is the cheap move now.
